verdict.rationale: Live probes show AnyDesk's help center serves a working llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a structured index of knowledge-base sections). A markdown docs endpoint (.md with frontmatter and a documentation index) also responds, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec for the REST API (all candidate paths 404), no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or markdown offering, and the depth and coverage of the llms.txt index are unverified beyond the truncated probe.
